current_finding: PR1015 selected matrix salt/Jarvis remains admitted. Its independent WALSAL01 successor now also admits selected Walsum/salinity, requalified after canonical empirical root frost. Fourteen named current-source groups pass; salt/frost and salt/Rutter production hybrids remain excluded.
historical_reconstruction: Source-family evidence distinguishes Maas-Hoffman switch 1 as a nodewise alpha(CML) from osmotic-head switch 2, which modifies matric-flux potential and requires Jong-van-Lier drought; switch 2 is not a separate multiplicative alpha_sol. Source-family census additionally establishes SWINCO-dependent initial versus warm-restart concentration profiles, CMSY inventory derived from water content/CML and optional Freundlich sorption, explicit boundary and drainage fluxes, internal solute substeps, and root salt uptake TSCF*qrot*CML. Exact B1.11 solute-member and restart details remain unverified in this execution. Exact B1.11 source has now been recovered by reconstructing the byte-verified historical SWAP 4.3.1 donor source ZIP; solute.f90 matches the pinned 51,508-byte member hash. Its drainage rule is level-resolved: qdra>0 removes at local CML and qdra<=0 imports at Cdrain. qssdi is absent from this solute balance; no concentration is defined there, so the reconstructed SWAP5 contract must keep it zero-solute or fail-closed. Cdrain is externally prescribed unless aquifer breakthrough swbr=1 owns a dynamic reservoir; bottom cseep can be separately prescribed/time varying. Root salt removal uses tscf*qrot*CML. Dispersion, sorption, decomposition, internal solute substeps, and aquifer breakthrough are present in source but remain outside the currently tested prototype envelope. Successor 571a76c473949dccd5e690261fea0d8a0a1ea15c now qualifies molecular/mechanical dispersion and internal solute stepping in the selected matrix envelope; the earlier exclusion statement records historical prototype scope.
